intro: Our affiliate partner program gives you the opportunity to automatically earn up to 10% commission every time someone books one of our rides using your unique link or promo code.

Our affiliate partner program is the perfect complement for accommodation providers, tourism operators and travel agents looking to showcase our region whilst earning commission for bookings as a thank you from us. It's easy to apply and once you're set up it's even easier to earn from referrals.
Register to become a promotional partner.
Add Link to your Website /Share Promo Code / Pin up Poster.
Offer your guests our range of exceptional horseback experiences.

sections.title: Booking Methods
body: Once approved, you'll receive a unique partner link. Any bookings made using your link earn 10% commission.
Display a poster with your unique QR code to earn 10% automatically.

sections.title: Partner Registration
body: Fill out the form and we'll get back to you once your account is set up.
